title: Research & Industry Experience
html:
Research & Industry Experience

Research Assistant

Penn State University · CENSAI Lab

May – July 2025

Researched arithmetic in LLaMA 3.2-3B using interpretability tools to trace intermediate calculations and operator precedence (PEMDAS). Developed an embedding-swap technique to alter precedence behavior. Authored a research paper accepted to CoLM and presented the findings at the conference.

Research Assistant

University of Delaware · Sensify Lab

June – Aug. 2025

Developed a speech improvement platform that visualizes voice qualities for practice, with a focus on gender-affirming voice training. Used Python, Librosa, and OpenSMILE to analyze and visualize pitch, resonance, formants, and other voice characteristics.

Robotics Researcher

Partners in Science · Liberty Science Center

July – Aug. 2025

Built a multi-robot warehouse inventory simulation using ROS, Gazebo, and deep reinforcement learning, integrating global task allocation with local robot decision-making. Conducted this research during an eight-week program at Columbia Engineering and presented it at the program symposium.

Software Engineering Intern

The Community Grocer, 501(c)(3)

May – Aug. 2024

Developed a web app for SNAP recipients to order food, coordinate community events, and schedule meal deliveries, increasing access to healthy food.

title: Projects
html:
Projects

Co-founder, Software Developer

Preventa AI

Aug. – Sept. 2025

Co-founded Preventa AI and developed PreventaAI, a healthcare app with medication tracking, an AI assistant, and a visual scanner. Built Eyesight, an accessibility app using LiDAR and on-device CoreML for obstacle detection and real-time narration.

Founder, Software Developer

Slicer AI

June – Nov. 2024

Founded and developed an AI tennis coaching app that uses 3D human pose estimation, cosine similarity, and 3D neural networks to correct tennis swings from video. Awards: 1st in the Congressional App Challenge (top 0.1%), 2nd at Penn State LionCage, 4th at Husky Dog Pound, and top 10 in the Diamond Challenge.

Researcher

Fibromyalgia Diagnosis

Nov. – Jan. 2024

Developed a machine learning approach to fibromyalgia diagnosis using HRV, GSR, and EMG signals, achieving approximately 94% test accuracy. Combined feature scaling, GAN augmentation, and GCN embeddings with a 2D CNN. Placed 3rd among 60+ Computer Science projects at the Delaware Valley Science Fairs and 1st at the CCRSC fair (2025).

Founder & Head Coach

Ace Tennis Academy LLC

Operated a youth tennis academy over four seasons, coaching 120+ players and hiring eight coaches. Managed operations, financial planning, marketing, web design, and sales.

Founder & Researcher

Socci Group — Predictive Hurricane Modeling

Developed Ridge, Log-Ridge, and KNN regression models to estimate U.S. post-hurricane economic damage using atmospheric and geolocation data. Trained on 17 storms and tested on 10; used feature reduction and regularization to address overfitting.
